title: Actor Nikita Rawal kissed by fan
summary: Nikita Rawal, an actor from the film 'Garam Masala', was kissed by a fan at an award show. The incident was captured on video and has gone viral on the internet. The fan's actions have caused a stir online. Nikita Rawal is known for her role in the film 'Garam Masala'. The video of the incident has been widely shared and discussed. The actor was attending an award show when the incident occurred.
